  (P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ O) (a : CGB.Energetics.Account P) (initial : S) (T : ℝ) (entropy : ℕ → (S → ℝ) → ℝ)
  (carriedEntropy : ℕ → S → O → S → ℝ),
  CGB.Energetics.Isothermal P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy →
    ∀ (lower supplyBound ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), lower ≤ CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ),
              ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t ≤ supplyBound) →
            ¬∀ (n : ℕ),
                ↑n * ε ≤
                  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
                    (CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t +
                      T * CGB.Energetics.production P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy t)

declarations.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {O : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype O]
  (P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ O) (a : CGB.Energetics.Account P) (initial : S) (T : ℝ) (entropy : ℕ → (S → ℝ) → ℝ)
  (carriedEntropy : ℕ → S → O → S → ℝ),
  CGB.Energetics.Isothermal P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t +
            T * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.production P a initial T entropy carriedEntropy t =
          CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy 0 +
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t ∧
        (∀ lower ≤ CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n,
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t ≤
              CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy 0 - lower +
                ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t) ∧
          (CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy n = CGB.Energetics.freeEnergy P a initial T entropy 0 →
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.flux P initial a.load t ≤
              ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Energetics.suppliedAvailability P a initial T carriedEntropy t)

  (z' : (Unit → CGB.ActiveLoop.State) × CGB.ActiveLoop.world.W),

    CGB.ActiveLoop.storedEnergy a z' + CGB.ActiveLoop.actionWork w_act z z' =
      CGB.ActiveLoop.storedEnergy a z + 0 + CGB.ActiveLoop.matterIntakeEnergy a z z' +

declarations.name: CGB.ActiveLoop.jointMachine._proof_1
declarations.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool) (t : ℕ) (z : (Unit → CGB.ActiveLoop.State) × CGB.ActiveLoop.world.W) (x : Unit)
  (z' : (Unit → CGB.ActiveLoop.State) × CGB.ActiveLoop.world.W),
  0 ≤
    if cut = true then
      (CGB.ActiveLoop.body.scheduledCutKernel CGB.ActiveLoop.world CGB.ActiveLoop.body_clock
            (fun x => CGB.ActiveLoop.world.sense) t).step
        z z'
    else
      (CGB.ActiveLoop.body.scheduledKernel CGB.ActiveLoop.world CGB.ActiveLoop.body_clock
            (fun x => CGB.ActiveLoop.world.sense) t).step
        z z'

declarations.name: CGB.ActiveLoop.jointMachine._proof_2
declarations.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool) (t : ℕ) (z : (Unit → CGB.ActiveLoop.State) × CGB.ActiveLoop.world.W),
  (∑ o,
      ∑ s',
        if cut = true then
          (CGB.ActiveLoop.body.scheduledCutKernel CGB.ActiveLoop.world CGB.ActiveLoop.body_clock
                (fun x => CGB.ActiveLoop.world.sense) t).step
            z s'
        else
          (CGB.ActiveLoop.body.scheduledKernel CGB.ActiveLoop.world CGB.ActiveLoop.body_clock
                (fun x => CGB.ActiveLoop.world.sense) t).step
            z s') =
    1

declarations.name: CGB.ActiveLoop.worldMoves._proof_1
declarations.signature: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: CGB.ActiveLoop.worldMoves.eq_1
declarations.signature:
∀ (w : CGB.ActiveLoop.WorldState) (x : Unit → CGB.ActiveLoop.State) (w' : CGB.ActiveLoop.WorldState),
  CGB.ActiveLoop.worldMoves w x w' =
    if w = 0 then if w' = 1 then 1 / 2 else if w' = 2 then 1 / 2 else 0
    else
      if w = 1 then if w' = 3 then 1 else 0
      else
        if w = 2 then if w' = 4 then 1 else 0
        else
          if w = 3 then if x () = 1 ∨ x () = 3 then if w' = 3 then 1 else 0 else if w' = 5 then 1 else 0
          else
            if w = 4 then if x () = 2 ∨ x () = 3 then if w' = 4 then 1 else 0 else if w' = 5 then 1 else 0
            else if w' = 5 then 1 else 0

declarations.signature:
∀ {C : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype C] (path : ℕ → C → CGB.MaterialSource.Place) (n : ℕ),
  CGB.MaterialSource.count (path n) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
          (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside) =
      CGB.MaterialSource.count (path 0) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
          (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source) →
    CGB.MaterialSource.count (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
          CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
            CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside =
        CGB.MaterialSource.count (path n) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
            CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside
              CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
          CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink
            CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source →
      ¬CGB.MaterialSource.count (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
              (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
                  (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
                      CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
                    CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
                      CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside) +
                (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
                    CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body +
                  CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source
                    CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside)) =
            CGB.MaterialSource.count (path 0) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
              (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
                  (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside
                      CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
                    CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path t) (path (t + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink
                      CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source) +
                (CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.outside
                    CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source +
                  CGB.MaterialSource.moved (path n) (path (n + 1)) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink
                    CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source)) →
        False
